hebrew_line: יִקָּו֨וּ הַמַּ֜יִם מִתַּ֤חַת הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ אֶל־מָק֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד וְתֵרָאֶ֖ה הַיַּבָּשָׁ֑ה
kjv_line: Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.

hebrew_line: וַיָּבֵא֙ אֶל־הָ֣אָדָ֔ם לִרְא֖וֹת מַה־יִּקְרָא־ל֑וֹ
kjv_line: and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them:

kjv_line: Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.

hebrew_line: כִּ֤י תַֽעֲבֹד֙ אֶת־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה לֹֽא־תֹסֵ֥ף תֵּת־כֹּחָ֖הּ לָ֑ךְ

hebrew_line: וְאַתֶּ֖ם פְּר֣וּ וּרְב֑וּ
kjv_line: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply;

hebrew_line: שִׁרְצ֥וּ בָאָ֖רֶץ וּרְבוּ־בָֽהּ׃
kjv_line: bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.

hebrew_line: וְעַתָּה֙ לֹֽא־יִבָּצֵ֣ר מֵהֶ֔ם כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָזְמ֖וּ
kjv_line: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined

hebrew_line: וַאֲגַדְּלָ֖ה שְׁמֶ֑ךָ וֶהְיֵ֖ה בְּרָכָֽה׃

hebrew_line: וַיְהִ֕י כְּב֥וֹא אַבְרָ֖ם מִצְרָ֑יְמָה וַיִּרְא֤וּ הַמִּצְרִים֙ אֶת־הָ֣אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּֽי־יָפָ֥ה הִ֖וא מְאֹֽד׃
kjv_line: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.

hebrew_line: שָׂ֣א נָ֤א עֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ וּרְאֵ֔ה מִן־הַמָּק֖וֹם
kjv_line: Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place

hebrew_line: תֶּן־לִ֣י הַנֶּ֔פֶשׁ וְהָרְכֻ֖שׁ קַֽח־לָֽךְ׃
kjv_line: Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.

hebrew_line: וְעַ֣ד שְׂרֽוֹךְ־נַ֔עַל וְאִם־אֶקַּ֖ח מִכָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לָ֑ךְ וְלֹ֣א תֹאמַ֔ר אֲנִ֖י
kjv_line: even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say,

hebrew_line: בַּמָּ֥ה אֵדַ֖ע כִּ֥י אִֽירָשֶֽׁנָּה׃
kjv_line: whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?

hebrew_line: יָדֹ֨עַ תֵּדַ֜ע כִּי־גֵ֣ר׀ יִהְיֶ֣ה זַרְעֲךָ֗ בְּאֶ֙רֶץ֙ לֹ֣א לָהֶ֔ם

kjv_line: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son,

hebrew_line: הִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ לְפָנַ֖י וֶהְיֵ֥ה תָמִֽים׃
kjv_line: walk before me, and be thou perfect.

hebrew_line: וְהִפְרֵתִ֤י אֹֽתְךָ֙ בִּמְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וּנְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְגוֹיִ֑ם וּמְלָכִ֖ים
kjv_line: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings

hebrew_line: וּבֵֽרַכְתִּ֙יהָ֙ וְהָֽיְתָ֣ה לְגוֹיִ֔ם מַלְכֵ֥י עַמִּ֖ים
kjv_line: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.

hebrew_line: הִנֵּ֣ה׀ בֵּרַ֣כְתִּי אֹת֗וֹ וְהִפְרֵיתִ֥י אֹת֛וֹ וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֥י אֹת֖וֹ

hebrew_line: נִצָּבִ֖ים עָלָ֑יו וַיַּ֗רְא וַיָּ֤רָץ לִקְרָאתָם֙ מִפֶּ֣תַח הָאֹ֔הֶל

kjv_line: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet,

hebrew_line: וְסַעֲד֤וּ לִבְּכֶם֙ אַחַ֣ר תַּעֲבֹ֔רוּ
kjv_line: and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on:

hebrew_line: אֵֽרֲדָה־נָּ֣א וְאֶרְאֶ֔ה
kjv_line: I will go down now, and see

kjv_line: And he spake unto him yet again, and said,

kjv_line: Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once:

kjv_line: bring them out unto us, that we may know them.

hebrew_line: אוֹצִֽיאָה־נָּ֤א אֶתְהֶן֙ אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וַעֲשׂ֣וּ לָהֶ֔ן כַּטּ֖וֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֑ם
kjv_line: let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes:

hebrew_line: וְאַֽל־תַּעֲמֹ֖ד בְּכָל־הַכִּכָּ֑ר הָהָ֥רָה הִמָּלֵ֖ט
kjv_line: neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain,

hebrew_line: וְאָנֹכִ֗י לֹ֤א אוּכַל֙ לְהִמָּלֵ֣ט הָהָ֔רָה פֶּן־תִּדְבָּקַ֥נִי הָרָעָ֖ה וָמַֽתִּי׃

hebrew_line: וַיְהִ֗י בְּשַׁחֵ֤ת אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־עָרֵ֣י הַכִּכָּ֔ר וַיִּזְכֹּ֥ר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֑ם

kjv_line: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.

hebrew_line: אֶ֤ל כָּל־הַמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָב֣וֹא שָׁ֔מָּה אִמְרִי־לִ֖י אָחִ֥י הֽוּא׃
kjv_line: at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.

hebrew_line: וַתֵּלֶךְ֩ וַתֵּ֨שֶׁב לָ֜הּ מִנֶּ֗גֶד הַרְחֵק֙ כִּמְטַחֲוֵ֣י קֶ֔שֶׁת
kjv_line: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot:

hebrew_line: וַֽיְהִי֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֗לֶךְ וּפִיכֹל֙ שַׂר־צְבָא֔וֹ אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֖ם

kjv_line: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying,

hebrew_line: גֵּר־וְתוֹשָׁ֥ב אָנֹכִ֖י עִמָּכֶ֑ם תְּנ֨וּ לִ֤י אֲחֻזַּת־קֶ֙בֶר֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם וְאֶקְבְּרָ֥ה מֵתִ֖י מִלְּפָנָֽי׃

hebrew_line: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתָּ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר אִם־יֵ֣שׁ אֶֽת־נַפְשְׁכֶ֗ם לִקְבֹּ֤ר אֶת־מֵתִי֙ מִלְּפָנַ֔י שְׁמָע֕וּנִי
kjv_line: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me,

hebrew_line: נָתַ֜תִּי כֶּ֤סֶף הַשָּׂדֶה֙ קַ֣ח מִמֶּ֔נִּי וְאֶקְבְּרָ֥ה אֶת־מֵתִ֖י שָֽׁמָּה׃

kjv_line: that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.

kjv_line: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in

hebrew_line: אֲנִי֩ טֶ֨רֶם אֲכַלֶּ֜ה לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־לִבִּ֗י וְהִנֵּ֨ה רִבְקָ֤ה יֹצֵאת֙
kjv_line: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her

kjv_line: shoulder, and said, Drink,

kjv_line: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.

hebrew_line: וַיֹּאכְל֣וּ וַיִּשְׁתּ֗וּ ה֛וּא וְהָאֲנָשִׁ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־עִמּ֖וֹ
kjv_line: And they did eat and drink, he and the men

hebrew_line: וַֽיהוָ֖ה הִצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכִּ֑י שַׁלְּח֕וּנִי וְאֵלְכָ֖ה לַֽאדֹנִֽי׃

kjv_line: and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.

hebrew_line: וַיִּגְוַ֨ע וַיָּ֧מָת אַבְרָהָ֛ם בְּשֵׂיבָ֥ה טוֹבָ֖ה

hebrew_line: וְאֶֽהְיֶ֥ה עִמְּךָ֖ וַאֲבָרְכֶ֑ךָּ

hebrew_line: וּבֵֽרַכְתִּ֙יךָ֙ וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֣י אֶֽת־זַרְעֲךָ֔
kjv_line: and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for

hebrew_line: וְצֵא֙ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה וְצ֥וּדָה לִּ֖י צָֽיִד׃

hebrew_line: וַעֲשֵׂה־לִ֥י מַטְעַמִּ֖ים וְאֹכֵ֑לָה

hebrew_line: וְהֵבֵאתָ֥ לְאָבִ֖יךָ וְאָכָ֑ל

hebrew_line: גְּשָׁה־נָּ֥א וַאֲמֻֽשְׁךָ֖ בְּנִ֑י הַֽאַתָּ֥ה זֶ֛ה בְּנִ֥י עֵשָׂ֖ו אִם־לֹֽא׃

hebrew_line: גְּשָׁה־נָּ֥א וּשְׁקָה־לִּ֖י בְּנִֽי׃
kjv_line: Come near now, and kiss me, my son.

hebrew_line: הֱוֵ֤ה גְבִיר֙ לְאַחֶ֔יךָ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲוּ֥וּ לְךָ֖ בְּנֵ֣י אִמֶּ֑ךָ
kjv_line: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother's sons bow down to thee:

hebrew_line: יָקֻ֤ם אָבִי֙ וְיֹאכַל֙ מִצֵּ֣יד בְּנ֔וֹ
kjv_line: Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison,

hebrew_line: וְעַל־חַרְבְּךָ֣ תִֽחְיֶ֔ה וְאֶת־אָחִ֖יךָ תַּעֲבֹ֑ד
